title: Secure log handoff: VPC/on‑prem forwarder with customer‑managed storage profiles
creator: Aisha K. Patel
description: Implement a hardened log handoff connector that enables private/VPC and on-prem deployments to forward audit logs to customer-managed storage endpoints (S3-compatible, GCS, Azure Blob) via configurable storage profiles. The feature must support tenant isolation, resumable uploads, CMEK/CMEK handshakes for key management, and administrative guardrails (RBAC v2 + SSO/SAML enforced actions). Goal: provide customers with an operator-controlled pattern to keep audit data in their storage while preserving provenance, non-repudiation, and system availability.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Admin UI / API: create storage profile with endpoint, region, auth method (signed-URL, IAM-role, access key, presigned-manifest), and retention policy; only users with 'audit:bind' RBAC permission can create or modify profiles.
2) Forwarder: forward audit events from private control plane to configured profile using resumable, chunked uploads and signed manifests; provide at-least-once delivery with idempotency keys.
3) CMEK: support encrypted handoff where the handoff message includes CMEK metadata and server-side encryption keys are validated.
4) Audit provenance: every forward includes manifest record with sequence, checksum, and operator identity (SAML subject) recorded in the control-plane ledger.
5) Failure modes: tolerant to transient network failures with backoff and local encrypted buffering; backpressure and circuit-breaker to avoid unbounded memory.
6) Tests: E2E test that simulates VPC egress failure and verifies resumable resume, signature verification, and manifests in customer bucket.
7) Docs: Console docs + API spec + runbook for on-prem operators.
implementation_todo: API: storage-profile CRUD + validation (support multiple auth modes)

Control plane: ledger entry for every manifest + link to operator identity
Auth: wire RBAC v2 permission 'audit:bind' into API checks
SSO: map SAML attributes -> admin roles for UI visibility and audit entries

Operator CLI: migrate existing forwarder configs to new profile format
E2E tests: network partition, CMEK key rotation, and resume scenarios
progress_updates: 2025-02-14: Design sync with Infra and Security. Decided on manifest format (NDJSON ledger entries + SHA256 checksums).
2025-02-20: Prototype of resumable uploader completed; validated multipart resume with local encrypted buffer. PR opened: runtime/pull/5143.
2025-02-26: Security requested explicit support for CMEK handshake and HSM-backed KMS ops; added as requirement.
2025-03-01: RBAC v2 'audit:bind' permission schema proposed and posted to design doc for review.
2025-03-03: Started implementing storage-profile API; blocked briefly by identity mapping gaps for SAML attribute 'roles'; Eng-51412 assigned to identity team.
testing_plan: Unit tests for uploader adapter, integration tests against localstack and GCS emulator, chaos tests to simulate egress failures, and an E2E runbook verified by Solutions Eng. Include replay tests for manifest idempotency and tests that validate operator identity propagation from SAML assertion into ledger entries.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag behind 'secure_log_handoff' for private deployments. 2) Beta to three customers with dedicated test buckets and runbook. 3) Monitor for delivery failures and manifest mismatch rate for 2 weeks. 4) Enable broader rollout and enable console flows after Beta signoff.
monitoring_slo: Delivery success rate >= 99.5% over 24h for committed manifests; average time-to-persist in customer storage < 60s for typical small batches. Alerts: >1% manifest failure rate or repeated resume attempts (>5 per minute) triggers P1 oncall.
risk_mitigation:
- Credentials: discourage storing long-lived access keys; prefer role-based or presigned manifests.
- Data loss: local encrypted buffer with TTL and forced retry policy.
- Authorization mistakes: require multi-person approval for deletion of storage profiles in console for orgs flagged as enterprise.
- Compliance: expose retention enforcement metadata but do not attempt to enforce deletion in customer buckets; provide operator checklist and sample lifecycle policies.
notes: This ticket intentionally separates 'storage profile' from concrete adapter logic so sales/legal can review supported auth flows per customer. Work ties closely to RBAC v2 rollout and SAML attribute mapping; coordinate with identity team (ENG-51412).
